plan.rationale: This operation explicitly supports grouping detected categories into separate baskets, assigning destinations by geometric transfer cost. The RGB views show three open baskets and objects suitable for category-based grasp-and-place sorting, with no specified category-to-basket mapping. Its observation-batch input and joint-action output match the execution contracts. Language-conditioned placement instead requires explicit basket mappings, while the learned compositions provide no stronger declared support for this task.
